cases.question: What is the hospitalization deductible?
cases.answer: The document states that the annual hospitalization deductible is five hundred dollars (500 USD) per insured person and one thousand dollars (1000 USD) per family per policy year.

cases.question: How much notice does the policyholder have to give to cancel the policy?
cases.answer: The document states that "The policyholder may cancel this policy at any time by giving thirty (30) days written notice to Acme Health Insurance." This is specified in Section 4 of the policy.

cases.question: What is the maximum annual coverage limit?
cases.answer: The document states that "The maximum annual coverage limit under this policy is one million dollars (1,000,000 USD) per insured person for all covered hospitalization and outpatient claims combined." This is specified in Section 2 of the Acme Health Insurance Policy.

cases.question: Within how many days must a claim be filed?
cases.answer: The document states that "Every claim must be filed within ninety (90) days of the date of service." This is specified in Section 5 of the policy. Claims filed after ninety days are denied unless the delay was caused by Acme.

cases.question: Is there a waiting period for pre-existing conditions?
cases.answer: The document states that "A waiting period of thirty (30) days applies to all claims arising from pre-existing conditions. No claim for a pre-existing condition is payable during the first thirty days of the policy." This confirms a 30-day waiting period for pre-existing conditions.
